title: AMQP envelope (v1)
description: AMQP 0-9-1 basic properties every v1 message carries (ADR 0002 "Message format"). The envelope is not part of the JSON body; this schema describes the properties as a JSON object so publishers, consumers and the examples can be checked. Body schemas are selected by `type`.

messageId.description: AMQP `message_id`. New UUID per logical message; a re-publish of the same message (outbox relay retry, worker retry after an unconfirmed publish) reuses it. Consumers de-duplicate on it.

correlationId.description: AMQP `correlation_id` = the job id the message is about.

type.description: AMQP `type`: `<family>.v<major>.<Name>`. Selects the body schema (see topology.md, message catalogue).

contentEncoding.description: Optional; bodies are always UTF-8 JSON, never compressed in v1.

deliveryMode.description: 2 (persistent) for everything on `lean.jobs`, `lean.jobs.dlx`, `lean.control` and for `status`/`result`/`order`/`error` events; 1 (transient) is allowed only for `heartbeat`, `progress` and `log` events and `lean.marketdata.live` batches.

timestamp.description: AMQP `timestamp`, Unix seconds when the publisher created the message.

appId.description: AMQP `app_id`: publishing service. `lean-engine` = the bus `Messaging` adapter inside the job's child Launcher process.

expiration.description: Per-message TTL in ms. Not used on `lean.jobs`; allowed for heartbeats/progress.

headers.description: Application headers. Unknown headers must be ignored (additive evolution).

contract-version.description: `<major>.<minor>` of the contract the publisher implements. Major must match the routing-key version (`v1`); consumers accept any minor.

attempt.description: Attempt the message belongs to. On `lean.jobs` it is the attempt the orchestrator expected when it published (1 for a new job); redelivered messages keep it, and the worker claims the real attempt over REST.

parent-job-id.description: Optimization id for child backtests; lets the optimizer filter its children without parsing bodies.

packet-type.description: LEAN `PacketType` name of the wrapped packet (packets.v1.* only), e.g. BacktestResult.

sequence.description: Per job attempt and publisher, monotonically increasing. Consumers order by it (with packet time/progress), never by arrival (ADR 0002).

x-delivery-count.description: Set by the broker on quorum-queue redeliveries; read-only for publishers.
